SV-11576.title: List and Tech View show the asset's year, make and model
SV-11576.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an asset {Asset-A} with a year, make, model and unit number.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C11576 Asset Year, and {Asset-A} is a 2022 Freightliner M2, unit C11576-U1.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} on {Asset-A} is Approved.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-37700.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
SV-11576.custom_steps:
1. Read the Asset column of {Work-order-1}'s row.
  2. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  3. Read the Asset column of {Work-order-1}'s row.
SV-11576.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Asset column reads the year, then make, then model, for example "2022 Freightliner M2". The year is not missing.
  • Step 2: Tech View shows, with {Work-order-1} in Unassigned or its lead technician's group.
  • Step 3: the Asset column reads the same text as in List, year first, for example "2022 Freightliner M2".

The PRD keeps List as in production; Chris Ward's later ruling (quoted in SV-11576, 20 Oct 2026) adds the year to List's Asset column, in the same format as the Board View card. This case follows the later ruling.

Known problem (SV-11576, In Progress; it goes into this release if it fits, otherwise a fast follow, Chris Ward, Slack #fs-board-tech-view, 20 Oct 2026): the Asset column shows the make and model with no year. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If the year shows, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 21 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10048 (Story 5, Choose what is shown)

  • Story 5, optional fields: “asset (year/make/model)”

From: Jira SV-11576, “Work Orders List – Asset column never shows the asset's year” (Slavcho Mitrov, 20 Oct 2026), quoting Chris Ward on Slack, 20 Oct 2026, read 21 Oct 2026

  • Expected: “The same format as the Board card: year make model (Chris, Slack, 20 Oct 2026: "yes, in the same format as the Board card… Put it in this release if you can; if not, a fast follow is fine"). Tech View rows share this cell, so they show the year too.”

Not yet checked against a build.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11576)

SV-11577.title: The Lines tab and Edit Line name the technician by their staff record name
SV-11577.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A}, and the name on their staff record differs from the name on their login account.
    For example: the staff record reads ZZAUTOTEST C11577 Ana Staff and the login account reads ZZAUTOTEST C11577 Ana Login.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} is Approved, led by {Technician-A}, and has one approved line, {Line-1}, with {Technician-A} as its technician.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-37701 and {Line-1} is "Service - Full grease service".
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on its "Lines" tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
SV-11577.custom_steps:
1. Read the technician name in {Line-1}'s Labor text.
  2. Read the technician name in {Line-1}'s technician list (roster).
  3. Click {Line-1}'s name to open Edit Line.
  4. Read the technician name under Technicians.
  5. Click "Cancel".
  6. Open "Work Orders", click the "All" tab and click "Board View".
  7. Read the technician name on {Work-order-1}'s card and its column header.
SV-11577.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Labor text names the technician by their staff record name, for example ZZAUTOTEST C11577 Ana Staff.
  • Step 2: the roster shows the same staff record name, not the login account name.
  • Step 3: Edit Line opens.
  • Step 4: Technicians shows the same staff record name.
  • Step 5: Edit Line closes and nothing changes.
  • Step 6: Board View shows.
  • Step 7: the card and the column header show the same staff record name.

Known problem (SV-11577, In Progress; this release if it fits, otherwise a fast follow): the roster and Edit Line show the login account name while the Labor text shows the staff record name, so one person appears under two names. (1) If you see exactly that at steps 2 or 4, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If every place shows the staff record name, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 21 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10048 (Story 5, Choose what is shown)

  • S5-R11b: “Every technician name in Tech View and Board View, on cards, rows, group headers, column headers and the names shown on hover over any technician avatar (S2-R10, S7-R1), is the technician’s staff record name, the same name the List’s Lead Technician column shows.”

From: Jira SV-11577, “Work order Lines tab – technician roster shows the account name, not the staff record name” (Slavcho Mitrov, 20 Oct 2026), quoting Chris Ward on Slack, 20 Oct 2026, read 21 Oct 2026

  • Expected: “The staff record name in both places, the same name List, Board View and Tech View show (PRD S5-R11b; Chris, Slack, 20 Oct 2026: "use the staff record name in both places, so the roster changes to match the Labor text… Same timing as #2", i.e. this release if possible, otherwise a fast follow).”

Not yet checked against a build.

SV-11588.title: On Windows Chrome the hand pointer has a black outline in Board and Tech View
SV-11588.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You are on a Windows computer in Chrome, with the standard Windows pointer.
    For example: Windows 11, one 1920 x 1080 screen.
  • {Location-A} has a technician {Technician-A} who leads at least one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}.
    For example: {Technician-A} is Esther Howard.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
SV-11588.custom_steps:
1. Point at {Work-order-1}'s card without clicking.
  2. Point at {Technician-A}'s column header.
  3. Start dragging {Work-order-1}'s card and hold it.
  4. Drop it back where it was.
  5. Click "Tech View" and point at {Work-order-1}'s row.
  6. Start dragging the row and hold it.
  7. Drop it back where it was.
  8. Click "List" and point at {Work-order-1}'s row.
SV-11588.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the pointer is an open hand, white with a clear black outline, easy to see on the white card.
  • Step 2: the same outlined open hand.
  • Step 3: the pointer is a closed hand with the black outline the whole time you hold the card.
  • Step 4: the card is back in its place.
  • Step 5: the outlined open hand.
  • Step 6: the outlined closed hand the whole time.
  • Step 7: the row is back in its place.
  • Step 8: List's pointer is unchanged from today.

Known problem (SV-11588, Open, fast follow): Chrome on Windows draws its own hands, which on some screens are pure white with no outline and disappear against the white cards. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If every hand has a black outline, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: Jira SV-11588, “Board View and Tech View: hand cursor turns invisible white on Windows; use our own outlined hand” (Chris Ward, product owner, 20 Oct 2026), read 21 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns)

  • Fix: “Replace the browser's grab and grabbing hands in Board View and Tech View with our own hand cursors: a white hand with a 2px black outline, the same shapes (open hand while hovering, closed hand while dragging), about 32px.”
  • Fix: “Apply it everywhere these views use a hand today: Board View cards and column headers, Tech View rows and group headers, and while dragging in either view.”
  • How to check: “On Windows in Chrome, hover a Board View card, a Tech View row and a technician header: the hand has a clear black outline on white and on blue.”
  • How to check: “Drag a card or row: the closed hand keeps its black outline the whole drag.”
  • How to check: “List and every other page are unchanged.”

Not yet checked against a build.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the pointer's drawing cannot be captured by browser automation; a person checks it on Windows
